recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x repeated same middle/base lower initiator), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through the first same-lower group rotation is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. The application module is stubbed, and only the immediate second same-lower logical-index-1/2 whole-group single=false rotation is retained as the measured transition.

local/opponent active and sole-bench histories beginning from an unrefreshed clean top-driven group q1/q2/q3 state, followed by one middle/base single=true reset, one same-lower whole-group rotation, and an immediate measured second whole-group rotation initiated by that same lower card

q1/q3 internal post-geometry and ten-probe collisions despite distinct raw turns, plus the q2 post collision against the clean pre-divergence checkpoint with the explicit top-BREAK bench displacement

Repeated lower/index-1-or-2 single=false turn mutation, sibling rotation, unchanged per-card BREAK flags, q1-to-q2 margin rewrite, and action payload used by this capture.
